intro.h2: Planned with military precision, designed by Carol
paragraphs: C&S Remodeling has handled bathroom remodeling in San Antonio since Scott and Carol Kressner started the company in 2015. It is still family-owned and family-run today, and it is both veteran-owned and woman-owned.

Scott's military and IT background shapes the schedule and the job site, while Carol leads design. Design, 3D renderings, plumbing, electrical and finish work all stay inside one company, so the crew builds from the same plan you approved on screen. Google reviewers mention bathroom and primary bathroom remodels more than any other type of job, and recent owner replies credit Scott, Carol and Joe by name.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in San Antonio, plus kitchens and additions

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom rebuilds handled in-house, from demolition and rough-in plumbing and electrical to waterproofing, tile and fixtures. A typical mid-range bath takes two to four weeks. C&S lists budget updates at $8,000 to $15,000, mid-range remodels at $15,000 to $35,000 and luxury rebuilds above $35,000.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel in San Antonio with a black-framed glass shower, marble-look wall tile and a wood shaker vanity

items.name: Walk-In Showers and Tub-to-Shower Conversions
items.blurb: Dated tubs come out for custom walk-in showers, or stay as freestanding tubs and combined tub-shower units. Primary bath remodels often add multiple shower heads, dual vanities and heated floors, and the waterproofing is done with San Antonio's humidity in mind.

image.alt: Walk-in shower in a San Antonio bathroom remodel with marble-look porcelain walls, matte black fixtures and a glass block window

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: C&S kitchen remodels run from roughly $25,000 for a small kitchen to $85,000, and full renovations usually take four to eight weeks. Quartz is the most requested countertop. Every kitchen starts with an in-home visit and an itemized written estimate before any work is scheduled.

image.alt: San Antonio kitchen remodel with flat-panel white cabinets, a veined quartz waterfall island, blue glass backsplash and black range hood

items.name: Custom Cabinets and Vanities
items.blurb: C&S builds its own cabinets, so it also takes cabinet-only jobs, from refacing to full replacement. The in-house shop means two to six weeks of lead time, one team that measures, builds and installs, and a protective topcoat on every bathroom cabinet to handle humidity.

image.alt: Custom navy bathroom vanity with brass pulls, white quartz top and round mirror built by C&S Remodeling in San Antonio

items.name: Whole-Home Remodeling and Additions
items.blurb: For bigger plans, the same team handles whole-home renovations and additions such as family rooms, sunrooms and in-law suites, keeping design, construction, plumbing and electrical under one company. One recent client hired C&S to remodel large parts of a first home before moving in.

image.alt: Open living area in a whole-home remodel by C&S Remodeling with wood-look floors and a two-story wall of windows

about.h2: Meet founders Scott and Carol Kressner
about.text: Scott and Carol Kressner founded C&S Remodeling in 2015, and the business is still family-owned and family-run. Scott brings a military and IT background to project management, which shows in organized job sites and timelines that hold. Carol brings the design eye, working with homeowners on vanity styles, cabinet finishes and tile so the technical work serves a room that feels personal. Together they lead a veteran-owned and woman-owned company from an office on Poss Road in San Antonio. Their cabinet shop builds the boxes in-house, and the blog answers practical questions, such as whether a bathroom can be remodeled in one week.

image.alt: C&S Remodeling team photo in San Antonio, TX

process.h2: Four steps from first visit to final walkthrough

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: The team visits your home, measures the space and talks through what works, what doesn't, your style and the scope you have in mind.

steps.title: Design and 3D rendering
steps.text: Carol and the design team develop the plan and a complimentary 3D rendering, so you can test layouts and materials before anything is ordered.

steps.title: Construction by one team
steps.text: Once you approve the design, C&S runs demolition, rough-in, waterproofing, tile and finishes with one coordinated crew and a clear timeline.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You walk the finished space with the team and review every detail. If something needs attention later, C&S returns at your request.

service_area.h2: Serving San Antonio and the Hill Country
service_area.text: C&S Remodeling works from its office at 6737 Poss Rd in San Antonio and serves homeowners across the city and the surrounding Hill Country. The towns below are the ones C&S names on its own site, from Alamo Heights and Shavano Park inside the metro to Boerne, Bulverde and New Braunfels farther out. Call with your address and the team will confirm whether your project and location are a fit.

faq.h2: Bathroom remodel questions we hear in San Antonio

items.q: How many weeks will my bathroom be out of service?
items.a: Most San Antonio bathroom remodels take two to four weeks. A typical mid-range job moves through demolition, rough-in plumbing and electrical, waterproofing and tile, then lighting, mirrors, hardware and a final quality check. Larger or custom bathrooms can take longer, and you get a clear timeline during planning.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost with C&S?
items.a: C&S publishes its ranges: about $8,000 to $15,000 for budget updates like a new vanity, toilet and lighting, $15,000 to $35,000 for mid-range remodels with new tile and a custom vanity, and beyond $35,000 for luxury rebuilds. Every project starts with a detailed written estimate and a complimentary 3D rendering.

Yes. C&S partners with several financing providers to offer flexible payment options for bathroom and kitchen remodels. Ask about current terms during your free consultation, and the team will help you find a plan that fits your budget before any work is scheduled.

items.q: Can you fix mold or water damage during a remodel?
items.a: Yes, and a remodel is the right time to do it. C&S works with licensed remediation specialists when needed, then installs moisture barriers and ventilation correctly so the problem does not come back. San Antonio's humidity makes careful waterproofing especially important behind shower walls.

Yes. Every remodeling project includes complimentary 3D renderings at no added cost. They let you compare layouts, materials and features before construction starts and give you, the designer and the crew one shared picture to work from. Detailed selections still come later, but the big decisions get made on screen.

final_cta.text: Call (210) 485-5424 or schedule a free consultation, and the C&S team will visit, measure and talk through your bathroom, kitchen or addition.
